item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 16/Jan/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of the dry winter monsoon, it will be persistently cold over Guangdong in the next couple of days. It will be mainly fine in the middle and latter parts of this week, the temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large. Temperatures are expected to rise slightly over the coastal areas on Lunar New Year's Eve and Lunar New Year's Day. Another surge of the northeast monsoon will reach southern China early next week. Temperatures will fall again and it will be rather cool in the morning over the region.
